name: compound-parenthetical
note: Safe arithmetic subset with parentheses and integer power. (1 + 10/100) = 1.1; 1.1 ^ 2 = 1.21 (exact BigDecimal for integer exponent); 1000000 * 1.21 = 1210000. The '^' here is the EvalEx native power OPERATOR with a literal integer exponent (exact), NOT the custom pow(base,exponent) function which routes through Math.pow on doubles. FCB and EvalEx agree exactly for this case.
